scope: HTML/CSS behavior and interactions across component, JavaScript and browser boundaries.
inputs: Captured crew selection and affected references
Exact-source hosted CI and sanitized evidence
checks: Trace state and data across component, JavaScript, DOM and CSS boundaries.
Check interaction ordering, cleanup, focus/keyboard behavior and error/empty states affected by the change.
Check combined framework behavior and request independent browser evidence; source review alone cannot establish runtime correctness.
evidenceRules: Cite observed owning code and affected callers.
Report missing evidence as blocked, not a pass.
Do not infer runtime behavior from source-only review.
